title: Deviations
intro: Where the plan and the linked Jira items disagree. Astrolabe only reads from Jira: nothing is written back, corrections are made in the plan.

flowSection.title: Capacity from Flow
flowSection.intro: Where a linked team's capacity in the plan differs from what Flow says for its current and future sprints. Astrolabe only reads from Flow: nothing is written back. Import capacity… on the team's page shows what an import would change; hand-entered periods are left as they are.
flowSection.loadFailed: Could not load the capacity comparison with Flow
flowSection.filtersNote: The plan item type, work stream, project, kind and connection filters do not apply to this section; the Status, team and severity filters do.
